verdict.rationale: Data residency is a fair question here, since skills.sh runs a hosted registry and leaderboard alongside its CLI. Nothing in the evidence documents choosing a storage region or residency. The project versus global install directories control where skill files land on the local filesystem, which is a related but different control and earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
